lean.statement:
theorem result
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (feature : Fin N → H) (i : Fin N)
    (replacement label : H) (b : ℝ)
    (hold : ‖feature i‖ ≤ b) (hnew : ‖replacement‖ ≤ b) :
    let m : H := (N : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ j, feature j
    let mNew : H := (N : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ j, Function.update feature i replacement j
    (‖mNew - label‖ ^ 2 - ‖m - label‖ ^ 2 -
      2 * ⟪m - label, mNew - m⟫_ℝ = ‖mNew - m‖ ^ 2) ∧
    ‖mNew - m‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * b ^ 2 / (N : ℝ) ^ 2
approved_definition_context: Function.update replaces exactly the selected index; equal feature values at other indices are unchanged. H has only the displayed real inner-product normed-space structures.
